questions: What type of event is the equity market rally?
Cypher Query:
MATCH (event:Entity {name: 'equity market rally'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (event)-[r]-(related:Entity)
RETURN event.name AS EventName,
       event.type AS EventType,
       CASE WHEN r IS NOT NULL THEN type(r) ELSE NULL END AS RelationshipType,
       CASE WHEN related IS NOT NULL THEN related.name ELSE NULL END AS RelatedEntity,
       CASE WHEN r IS NOT NULL THEN r.date ELSE NULL END AS Date,
       CASE WHEN r IS NOT NULL THEN r.source_url ELSE NULL END AS SourceURL,
       CASE WHEN r IS NOT NULL THEN r.source_text ELSE NULL END AS Evidence

questions: Which sector do Apple, Alphabet, and Nvidia all operate in?
Cypher Query:
MATCH (apple:Entity)-[r_apple:Operates_In]->(sector:Entity {type: 'SECTOR'})
WHERE apple.name CONTAINS 'Apple' OR apple.ticker = 'AAPL'
MATCH (alphabet:Entity)-[r_alphabet:Operates_In]->(sector)
WHERE alphabet.name CONTAINS 'Alphabet' OR alphabet.ticker IN ['GOOG', 'GOOGL']

WHERE nvidia.name CONTAINS 'NVIDIA' OR nvidia.ticker = 'NVDA'
RETURN sector.name AS CommonSector,
       r_apple.source_url AS AppleSourceURL,
       r_apple.source_text AS AppleEvidence,
       r_alphabet.source_url AS AlphabetSourceURL,
       r_alphabet.source_text AS AlphabetEvidence,
       r_nvidia.source_url AS NvidiaSourceURL,
